weaknesses.title: PUSHF arg var ITEM silently pushes "1"
weaknesses.detail: DEFAULT ITEM="deploy-a"; PUSHF q bag ITEM → bag becomes "1" not deploy-a. Form-token collision (ITEM reserved). Must use JOB/WORKITEM. Same class as COL/SEP/FLOOR/CAP/NEEDLE.
weaknesses.repro: DEFAULT ITEM="deploy-a"; PUSHF q bag ITEM → bag 1

weaknesses.title: DUMPOBJ multiline field breaks plate LOOKUP
weaknesses.detail: Bag with newlines written as raw lines; LOOKUP bag returns only first line. Cross-run rehydrate loses queue body. Workaround: dump/wN.bag side files for bag/keep.
weaknesses.repro: DUMPOBJ after PUSHF a\nb\nc; LOOKUP bag → a only

weaknesses.title: GREPF needle var NEEDLE mis-filters
weaknesses.detail: DEFAULT NEEDLE="error"; GREPF q bag NEEDLE → GREPF_N=1 wrong (literal/token collision). Rename to WANT. Silent wrong triage.
weaknesses.repro: GREPF bag NEEDLE with NEEDLE=error → N=1 not 2

weaknesses.title: GREPF/LINEF mutate field (destructive filter/peel)
weaknesses.detail: GREPF no-match empties bag (data loss). LINEF replaces bag with one line. Must snapshot keep before filter/peek-on-copy.
weaknesses.repro: GREPF zzz → bag empty; keep holds prior if snapshotted

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON bag hides newlines
weaknesses.detail: JSON string of multiline bag collapses visually; agents must WRITE bag file or SYS EQS.
weaknesses.repro: PRINT_JSON bag after PUSHF three jobs

weaknesses.title: REQUIRE=abc softens
weaknesses.detail: Non-numeric REQUIRE miss exit 0 on gate deny.

workarounds: Never name PUSHF payload ITEM — use JOB
Never name GREPF needle NEEDLE — use WANT
Persist bag/keep to dump/wN.bag side files; do not trust DUMPOBJ multiline
Snapshot keep before GREPF/LINEF; empty POP HIT=0
Fixed w0/w1/w2; TRY* soft; numeric REQUIRE only
language_gaps: Reserve ITEM/NEEDLE/COL/SEP in form arg slots or soft-error
DUMPOBJ escape multiline field values (quoted plate)
Single-object field SNAPSHOTF for bag keep
WRITE NL; strict NUM REQUIRE; PRINT_JSON escape \n
